### Installing (read this first)

**Android 8.0+:** download `OpenFlow-Android.apk` below on your phone and open it. Allow your browser to *install unknown apps* if asked, and tap **Install anyway** if Play Protect warns (it does that for any app outside the Play Store).
Then open OpenFlow and do the four setup steps **in order**: 1) allow the microphone, 2) open Accessibility (Android says *Restricted setting*, which is expected), 3) **App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings**, 4) turn the overlay on. Then download **Whisper Small** in *Speech recognition* for the best accuracy.
*(The ⋮ entry only appears after step 2 has been blocked once.)* Guide: [docs/INSTALL-ANDROID.md](https://github.com/PremKishore27/openflow-android/blob/main/docs/INSTALL-ANDROID.md)

**Updating:** *About → Check for updates*, then install over the old version. *Coming from 0.10 or older? Uninstall once first (those builds used a temporary key).*

**iPhone / iPad (iOS 17+):** install `OpenFlow-iOS-unsigned.ipa` with Sideloadly or AltStore using your Apple ID. Guide: [docs/INSTALL-IPHONE.md](https://github.com/PremKishore27/openflow-android/blob/main/docs/INSTALL-IPHONE.md)
